controls.description: Translation vector (0,0) when non-zero placement is required
controls.test: Authority check: recorded translation must match recomputed authority (source bbox center - exported bbox center). Zero translation fails because authority is ~6600-10500m.
controls.evidence: All 20 tiles have non-zero translation in placement field; zero translation would produce authority_check error >10m

controls.description: Translation applied twice (2x the correct value)
controls.test: Authority check: recorded translation must equal recomputed authority within 10m. Double translation would produce ~2x authority value.
controls.evidence: Authority check tolerance is 10m; double translation would produce error >1000m

controls.description: Tile index in manifest does not match actual tile directory
controls.test: Binding check: placement.tile_index must equal [tx, ty] from directory name.
controls.evidence: All 20 manifests have correct integer tile_index matching their directory

controls.description: Using incorrect rebase offset (e.g., omitting or swapping dx/dy)
controls.test: Authority check recomputes using canonical REBASE_DX/DY from frame contract. Wrong rebase shifts authority by ~100s of km.
controls.evidence: Authority check uses canonical REBASE_DX=832671.676, REBASE_DY=5458671.104 from coordinate_frame_contract

controls.description: Source OSM SHA256 in placement does not match actual OSM file
controls.test: Binding check: placement.source_osm_sha256 must equal sha256(tile_*/Ingolstadt_Tile_*.osm).

controls.description: Exported FBX SHA256 in placement does not match manifest fbx.sha256
controls.test: Binding check: placement.exported_fbx_sha256 must equal manifest.fbx.sha256.

controls.description: X and Y components of translation swapped
controls.test: Authority check: recorded translation components must match authority components within 10m. X/Y swap produces error ~|Tx - Ty| which is >10m for all tiles.
controls.evidence: For tile 6,8: T=(6604, 8502); swap gives error ~1900m > 10m

controls.test: Authority check: recorded Y must match authority Y within 10m. Reflection produces error ~2*|Ty| > 10m.
Authority check: 100x scale produces error ~100x authority > 10m.
Authority check: 0.01x scale produces error ~0.99x authority > 10m.

controls.description: Misusing EPSG:32632 CRS as the native frame
controls.test: Schema check: placement.source_frame must be 'NATIVE'. EPSG:32632 is a distinct CRS requiring reprojection.
controls.evidence: All 20 manifests have source_frame='NATIVE'; any deviation fails schema check

controls.description: Using outdated coordinate frame contract version
controls.test: Schema check: placement.schema_version must equal current CONTRACT_VERSION (1.0.0).
controls.evidence: All 20 manifests have schema_version='1.0.0'; stale version fails version check
